ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level analysis indicates an approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity light-gray/white pixels in the central lobe regions to low-intensity black pixels along the peripheral margins and peduncle base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity black pixels form contiguous bands along the entire trailing edge and peduncle intersection; high-intensity light-gray mottled regions are centered in both lobes; a distinct 2D black pigmentation cluster is located in the lower-medial region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated acute V-shaped notch with a sharp vertex angle of approximately 38 degrees, extending deeply into the central fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration across the continuous boundary; the right lobe trailing edge exhibits significant high-amplitude jaggedness (10-20 pixel deviations) compared to the more uniform, low-amplitude ripples of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The outer edges exhibit a strong convex curvature sweeping laterally and upward from the peduncle toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of numerous high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (2-6 pixel diameter) scattered across the black margins, with significant clusters localized at the distal tips corresponding to barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several fine, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible originating from the lower margin of the left lobe and extending into the lighter central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation and tissue loss on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe; prominent clusters of sessile barnacles (Coronula diadema) are present at the extreme terminals of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, dark, kidney-shaped pigmentation focal spot is present in the lower-inner quadrant of the right lobe, contrasted against a light-gray mottled background.
